# HUMINT

> AI consulting by Dina Bosma-Buczynska. Human intelligence, AI powered. Strategy, implementation, and the bridge between them. Berlin-based, available in English, German, and Dutch.

- [Community](/ai-noob-club/community): Founders community signup.
